audience: developers and teams who send text messages with D7 Networks

useCases.title: Check how much credit is left
useCases.text: The AI reads the remaining credit balance of the D7 account. Reading it spends no credit.

useCases.title: Look up the price per SMS for a country
useCases.text: The AI reads the price per SMS part for one country or for all countries on your account. You can estimate a cost before you send.

useCases.title: Check whether a text message was delivered
useCases.text: The AI reads the delivery status of an SMS request for each recipient, such as delivered, not reachable or insufficient credit, with message parts and cost.

useCases.title: Look up a phone number's carrier data
useCases.text: The AI looks up one phone number for country, network, MCC/MNC, ported and reachable status. Each lookup uses credit; an earlier lookup can be re-read by request id.

useCases.title: Send one text message to up to 10 recipients
useCases.text: The AI sends one SMS to 1 to 10 recipients. It can check the price per country first. Each message part uses credit.
